_about: Public-domain Charles John Ellicott (1819-1905), Bishop of Gloucester and Bristol, chairman of the New Testament revisers, for the Word Hoard: his critical and grammatical commentaries on St Paul's epistles (Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians-Colossians-Philemon, Thessalonians, 1 Corinthians), the Hulsean Historical Lectures on the Life of our Lord (1860), The Destiny of the Creature (1862), Considerations on the Revision of the New Testament (1870), Modern Unbelief (1877), Christus Comprobator (1892) and Sermons at Gloucester (1905), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 47 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ellicott-galatians: St. Paul's Epistle to the Galatians : with a critical and grammatical commentary and a revised translation (London : Longmans, Green, 1867)
ellicott-ephesians: St. Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians : with a practical and grammatical commentary, and a rev. translation (London : Longman, Green, Longman, Roberts & Green, 1864)
ellicott-philippians-colossians: St. Paul's epistles to the Philippians, the Colossians and Philemon : with a critical and grammatical commentary, and a revised translation (London : Longman, Green, Longman, Roberts & Green, 1865)
ellicott-thessalonians: St. Paul's epistles to the Thessalonians : with a critical and grammatical commentary, and a revised translation (London : Longman, Green, Longman, Roberts & Green, 1866)
ellicott-1-corinthians: St. Paul's First epistle to the Corinthians : with a critical and grammatical commentary (London : Longmans, Green, 1887)
ellicott-life-of-our-lord: Historical lectures on the life of Our Lord Jesus Christ : being the Hulsean lectures for the year 1859 (London : J. W. Parker, 1859)
ellicott-destiny-creature: The destiny of the creature : and other sermons, preached before the University of Cambridge (London : Parker, Son, and Bourn, 1862)
ellicott-revision: Considerations on the revision of the English version of the New Testament (London : Longmans, Green, Reader, and Dyer, 1870)
ellicott-modern-unbelief: Modern unbelief : its principles and characteristics, six addresses (London : The Christian Evidence Committee of the Society for Promoting Christian Knowledge ; New York : Pott, Young, 1877)
ellicott-christus-comprobator: Christus comprobator ; or, The testimony of Christ to the Old Testament : seven addresses (London : Society for promoting Christian knowledge, 1892)
ellicott-sermons-gloucester: Sermons at Gloucester (London : James Nisbet & Co., 1905)
